text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haha! The honor of first spear is mine!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My adversaries were all truly formidable, 
and yet—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I proved that my blade was the keenest of 
all. 
What an exhilarating feeling!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Have I managed, in some small way, 
to repay my debt to the club?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I shall report to everyone. 
That thanks to them, I emerged victorious 
today—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That their presence spurred me onward— 
I must express my gratitude to them once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
It is just as you say.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
'Tighten your helmet strings after 
victory'— 
how many times have I been told those 
words?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to put that teaching into 
practice. 
We return to our training. Are you 
prepared as well?
